profile.headline: Motivated software engineer, excited to learn new things and solve problems.
profile.summary:
Hard working individual with a great personality. Has the ability to learn quickly and apply new technologies. Strong desire to learn.

Specialties: Java/Grails/Groovy software development, debugging, problem solving,  user interface design, user interface evaluation, XML, XSLT, XPath, webservices, Docker, continuous integration, the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

positions.title: Research Scientist II
positions.description: Software engineer, primarily, for the N-DEx and LEXS projects within the IEAD division of GTRI. Tasks involve design and development of web services and web applications, development of tools for processing xml files, support for the ConTesA application, and assisting with numerous other projects in the lab.

volunteerExperiences.description: Soccer coach for the U6 soccer program.
